why_green_tests_missed_reported_problems: Native mechanic outcome tests can pass while discovery never offers the action or public capture omits its identity. Direct .apply is valid low-level coverage but bypasses Entity.perform/worker/capture acceptance.

The existing generic worker spell transport test covers16spell shapes but asserts records/noncanceled native events, not exact consumer-required lifecycle/selector/attribution fields, all facets or independent perspectives.
Several publication tests inject already-populated recorded attribution values; these protect projection/replay handling but do not prove real producers create those values.
Deterministic HP/dice/resource/condition checks are meaningful, but cannot substitute for exact per-owner/app/result identity or selected options on misses.

Some reported absences are contract differences or unconfirmed paths, not automatically production bugs: voluntary prone is explicitly excluded; bead power needs a public presentation decision; Help stale_state was not reproduced though a separate real worker-selection failure was.
